outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to anticipate beneficial airway management techniques and modalities in increasingly complex situations.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to anticipate potential equipment failures based on usage patterns and patient needs and implement solutions.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze appropriate therapeutic responses to interventions and communicate to the healthcare team.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to perform the clinical procedural skills associated with the role and scope of practice of the advanced respiratory care practitioner in the intensive care units, including neonatal and pediatric care, in the healthcare setting.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to differentiate between respiratory diseases.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply the principles of advanced cardio life support certifications to all rapid response and cardiac arrest patients.
